Method of Attack: Remote code execution due to passing unvalidated input from a file into a string-type eval, specifically evaluation of Number format strings within the Excel parsing logic
Discoverer: U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA)
Attack Vector: Exploitation of remote code execution vulnerability in Spreadsheet::ParseExcel library
Indicators of Compromise: Exploitation by Chinese hackers targeting Barracuda ESG appliances
Deployment of ‘SeaSpy’ and ‘Saltwater’ malware by threat actor UNC4841
